subject: general
question: R gives (3)/(8) of the toffees he has with him to S. If now R has k% of the toffies with S, then find the value of k.
solution:
**Given:**

R gives (3)/(8) of his toffees to S

After giving, R has k% of the toffees with S

Calculations:

If total toffees = x, then:

R gives = (3/8)x to S

R is left with = x − (3/8)x = (5/8)x

S has = (3/8)x

k% = (R's toffees ÷ S's toffees) × 100

k% = [(5/8)x ÷ (3/8)x] × 100

⇒ k% = (5/3) × 100 = 500/3%

**∴ Value of k = 500/3%**
